findings.description: PATCH /admin/bookings/:id/status uses updateMany as an optimistic lock then reads the final state with an unconditioned findUnique. A concurrent request that wins the lock and immediately makes another transition can cause the response to reflect a status this request did not set, misleading the caller.
findings.fix: Replace the updateMany + findUnique pattern with a single prisma.booking.update({ where: { id, status: booking.status }, data }) call. Prisma throws P2025 if the row's status changed since the earlier read; catch that and return a 400.

findings.description: The Venues panel loads all venues in one request and filters client-side, while Bookings and Users both use server-side search and pagination. This is harmless at current scale but diverges from the established pattern.
findings.fix: Consider aligning venue search with the server-side pattern used by the other panels, or explicitly document the intentional exception to prevent it being copied as the default approach.
